sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL entry APR-009 still reads approved with no end date. The newer 8D report records that the HB-620 approval was revoked on 2026-09-15, and today is 2026-11-14. The ASL record is therefore outdated and Fonderia Dora has no current approval for HB-620 at Pinerolo for Nordhavn. Continued ordering is not allowed until the approval is reinstated.

sources.quote: porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings (AlSi9Cu3), three escapes to the Nordhavn line

findings.why: Fonderia Dora has an open 8D on the AlSi9Cu3 material of HB-620, which is the part being re-ordered.

porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings

findings.why: The measured porosity of grade 4 in the mount bores fails the special characteristic, which requires grade 2 or better.
